product_launches.description: Loft launched Loft/Repasse in October 2025, a payments automation tool for real estate agencies that handled R$10 million in its first month and targets R$100 million in monthly volume by end-2026.

overview_description.description:
Loft leverages a tight-knit network of brokerage partners, an end-to-end digital workflow, and proprietary transaction data to facilitate the insurance, financing, lease, purchase, and sale of hundreds of thousands of homes in Latin America every year. 

Founded in 2018, the company combines data, software, and embedded fintech to digitize and simplify all parts of the real estate journey – from property listing to closing, financing, and rental management. 

Partnering with thousands of real estate brokerages, Loft is accelerating the modernization of one of Brazil’s largest and most fragmented industries by empowering real estate professionals with digital infrastructure and financial tools. 

Loft is headquartered in São Paulo.

about_short_description.short_description: Loft is Brazil’s market leader across rent guarantees, broker services, mortgage origination, and real estate fintech.

product.name: Loft Property Marketplace
product.description: An online marketplace for buying and renting apartments, houses, land, and farms across Brazil, with property search, listings, curated options, and virtual tours.

product.name: Fiança Aluguel (Rental Guarantee)
product.description: A digital rental guarantee that allows tenants to lease without a traditional guarantor or security deposit while providing landlords with rent-payment protection.

product.name: Financiamento Imobiliário (Real Estate Financing)
product.description: A mortgage-origination service that helps consumers and real estate agencies arrange financing for property purchases through a digital process.

identifier.value: Loft Real Estate Brokerage and Transaction Services

product.name: Loft Real Estate Brokerage and Transaction Services
product.description: Technology-enabled brokerage services that connect buyers, sellers, renters, property owners, and real estate agencies throughout property transactions.

identifier.value: Calculadora de Preços Loft (Loft Property Price Calculator)

product.name: Calculadora de Preços Loft (Loft Property Price Calculator)
product.description: A free online property valuation tool that estimates an asking price using market transaction data and comparable properties in the same region.

product.name: Loft Insurance Solutions
product.description: Residential and commercial insurance offerings distributed through Loft’s real estate-agency solutions for protecting rented or owned properties.
